exploration.name: Hammer Burn
exploration.description: Smith swings his hammer forward in a devastating arc, dealing Attack 200%/220%/240%/260%/280% damage.

exploration.name: Armor Enhancement
exploration.description: Smith upgrades his armor to reduce damage taken by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30%.

expedition.name: Burnished Iron
expedition.description: Smith's contagious passion for the art of crafting has raised City Iron Mine Output by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.name: Craftsmanship
expedition.description: Smith has an extraordinary sixth sense when it comes to iron. +5%/10%/15%/20%/25% Iron Gathering Speed on the map.

exploration.name: Axe Whirl
exploration.description: Eugene's axe pirouette deals damage of Attack *80%/88%/96%/104%/110% per 0.5s to nearby enemies for 3s.

exploration.name: Razor Sharp
exploration.description: Eugene's sharpened axe deals 10%/15%/20%/25%/30% more damage per second.

expedition.name: Woodland Inheritor
expedition.description: Eugene's consummate knowledge of timber processing has raised City Sawmill Output by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.name: Master Woodcutter
expedition.description: Eugene is always focused on achieving the perfect logging technique. +5%/10%/15%/20%/25% Wood Gathering Speed on the map.

exploration.name: Shrapnel Load
exploration.description: Charlie throws out a homemade explosive, dealing Attack 140%/154%/168%/182%/196% Area of Effect Damage to the target and its nearby enemies.

exploration.name: Grenadier
exploration.description: Charlie's grenades have a 10%/15%/15%/20%/20% chance of stunning targets for 0.5/0.5/1/1/1.5s.

expedition.name: Demolitions Expert
expedition.description: Charlie's precise demolition experience has raised City Coal Mine Output by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.name: Coal Extraction
expedition.description: Charlie is an old hand at coal mining. +5%/10%/15%/20%/25% Coal Gathering Speed on the map.

exploration.name: Rain of Arrows
exploration.description: Cloris launches a hail of arrows, dealing Attack180%/198%/216%/234%/252% Area of Effect Damage around the target.

exploration.name: Hunter's Mark
exploration.description: Cloris paints a bullseye on a target, raising damage inflicted on the target by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30% for this attack.

expedition.name: Top Hunter
expedition.description: Cloris, the tundra's best hunter, has single-handedly raised City Hunter's Hut Output by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.name: Predator
expedition.description: Cloris knows the ecosystem like the back of her hand. +5%/10%/15%/20%/25% Meat Gathering Speed on the map.

exploration.name: Shielded Strike
exploration.description: Sergey gives an enemy a solid whack with his heavy shield, knocking the target back while dealing Attack*200%/220%/240%/260%/280% Area of Effect damage.

exploration.name: Joint Defense
exploration.description: Sergey can organize strong perimeters, increasing all friendly hero Defense by 5%/7.5%/10%/12.5%/15%

exploration.name: Shield Block
exploration.description: Sergey trades in his shield for an upgraded model, reducing damage taken by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30%.

expedition.name: Defenders' Edge
expedition.description: Sergey's guards our troops with his shield, reducing damage taken by 4%/8%/12%/16%/20% for all troops.

expedition.name: Weaken
expedition.description: Sergey's intimidating presence reduces Attack by 4%/8%/12%/16%/20% for all enemy troops.

exploration.name: Burst Fire
exploration.description: Jessie sprays enemies in a forward arc with her machine gun, dealing Attack*55%/60%/65%/70%/75% damage every 0.5s for 2s.

exploration.name: Defense Upgrade
exploration.description: Jessie upgrades her armor, increasing Defense by 25%/37.5%/50%/62.5%/70%.

exploration.name: Weapon Upgrade
exploration.description: Jessie's upgraded weapon boosts Attack by 8%/12%/16%/20%/24%.

expedition.name: Stand of Arms
expedition.description: Jessie implement advanced weaponry for our troops, increasing damage dealt by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% for all troops.

expedition.name: Bulwarks
expedition.description: With a keen engineering eye, Jessie enhances troops armor, reducing damage taken by 4%/8%/12%/16%/20% for all troops.

exploration.name: BBQ Feast
exploration.description: Patrick prepares a lavish feast, restoring Health by Attack*200%/220%/240%/260%/280% to all troops and increasing Attack by 5%/5.5%/6%/6.5%/7% for all troops for 4s.

exploration.name: Thick Belly
exploration.description: Patrick's protective blubber reduces damage taken by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30%.

exploration.name: Emergency Snack
exploration.description: Patrick's regular snacking restores Health equal to Attack*50%/55%/60%/65%/70% every 5s.

expedition.name: Super Nutrients
expedition.description: Patrick's culinary masterpieces invigorate our troops, increasing Health by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% for all troops.

expedition.name: Caloric Booster
expedition.description: Patrick's gourmet meals motivate and unleash the potential of our soldiers, increasing Attack by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% for all troops.

exploration.name: Earthshake
exploration.description: Lumak Bokan lets out an intimidating war cry, reducing Attack by 1%/2%/3%/4%/5% for all enemy troops for 2s.

exploration.name: Echoing Boost
exploration.description: Beyond intimidating enemies, Lumak Bokan’s war cry invigorates allies. Upon casting Earthshake, increases his and nearby friendly troops’ Attack by 15%/20%/25%/30%/35% for 2s.

exploration.name: Jungle-Born Agility
exploration.description: Years of fighting in the jungles and mountains grant Lumak Bokan swift agility, increasing Attack Speed by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30%.

expedition.name: Tactical Deception
expedition.description: With Lumak Bokan's expert guerrilla tactics, all enemy troops' damage dealt is reduced by 4%/8%/12%/16%/20%.

expedition.name: Emerald Warrior
expedition.description: Lumak Bokan passes his people's traditional techniques to the soldiers, increasing Hunting March Speed by 20%/40%/60%/80%/100%.

exploration.name: Hurricane Whirl
exploration.description: Ling Xue slashes the area ahead with stormlike fury, dealing Attack*300%/330%/360%/390%/420% damage.

exploration.name: Galeforce
exploration.description: Ling Xue commands the Iron Eagles with strength and honor, increasing Attack by 16%/24%/32%/40%/48% when over 50% Health.

exploration.name: Desperate Measures
exploration.description: Ling Xue is at her most cunning when cornered, gaining 50%/75%/100%/125%/150% Defense when under 50% Health.

expedition.name: Fearsome Aura
expedition.description: Ling Xue's withering assault has disturbed enemies' formation, reducing all enemy Troops' Attack by 4%/8%/12%/16%/20%.

expedition.name: Total Control
expedition.description: Ling Xue's hands-on, disciplined instruction increases Training Speed by 4%/8%/12%/16%/20%.

exploration.name: Incendiary Arrow
exploration.description: Gina’s Incendiary Shot deals Attack*210%/230%/250%/270%/290% damage to an enemy target as well as Attack*70%/77%/84%/91%/98% damage to others nearby.

exploration.name: Windtalker
exploration.description: Gina improves the design of her crossbow, increasing Attack Speed by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30%.

exploration.name: Eagle Eyes
exploration.description: Gina can quickly latch onto an enemy's weakness, increasing Crit Rate by 7%/10%/13%/16%/20%.

expedition.name: Endurance Training
expedition.description: Gina's strict Governor training regimen can be counted upon to reduce Stamina cost by 10%/12%/15%/18%/20%.

expedition.name: Quick Paced
expedition.description: Gina is a fast and aggressive wilderness rider, boosting Wilderness March Speed by 20%/40%/60%/80%/100%.

exploration.name: Precise Shot
exploration.description: Bahiti targets enemy weak points with devastating precision, dealing Attack*400%/440%/480%/520%/560% damage.

exploration.name: Quick Shot
exploration.description: Bahiti gains +10%/15%/20%/25%/30% Attack Speed as he is very experienced in wilderness survival.

exploration.name: Pathfinder Vision
exploration.description: Bahiti deals 10%/15%/20%/25%/30% extra damage.

expedition.name: Sixth Sense
expedition.description: Bahiti's senses for dangers ahead, reducing damage taken by 4%/8%/12%/16%/20% for all troops.

expedition.name: Fluorescence
expedition.description: Bahiti's battlefield instinct grants all troops' attack a 50% chance of increasing damage dealt by 10%/20%/30%/40%/50%.

exploration.name: Triple Volley
exploration.description: Jasser precisely aims and fires three consecutive bullets, dealing Attack*100%, Attack *125%/137.5%/150%/162.5%/175%, and Attack*150%/165%/180%/195%/210% damage respectively, with the third being area of effect damage.

exploration.name: Suppressive Fire
exploration.description: Jasser relies on masterful marksmanship and overwhelming firepower to suppress the enemy, dealing Attack*100%/110%/120%/130%/140% damage and reducing the target's Attack Speed by 30%/35%/40%/45%/50% for 2s.

exploration.name: Natural Precision
exploration.description: Jasser's impeccable marksmanship has become second nature, increasing Attack by 8%/12%/16%/20%/24%.

expedition.name: Tactical Genius
expedition.description: Jasser's combination of courage and wisdom enriches the army, increasing damage dealt by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% for all troops.

expedition.name: Enlightened Warfare
expedition.description: Jasser's profound knowledge increases the city's Research Speed by 3%/6%/9%/12%/15%.

exploration.name: Heartbeat of Valor
exploration.description: Seo-yoon lifts the army's spirits with invigorating drum beats, increasing all troops' Attack by 1.5%/2%/2.5%/3%/3.5% and Attack Speed by 2.5%/3%/3.5%/4%/4.5% for 4s.

exploration.name: Bullseye Bash
exploration.description: Seo-yoon aims for the enemy's weak spot and hurls the drumstick with full force, dealing Attack*150%/165%/180%/195%/210% damage.

exploration.name: Gale's Pulse
exploration.description: Seo-yoon dances to the rhythm, sharpening her assault. For every 3 basic attacks, increases Attack Speed by 1%/2%/3%/4%/5%. Lasts until the end of the battle.

expedition.name: Rallying Beat
expedition.description: Seo-yoon beats the war drum to boost morale, increasing Troops Attack by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.name: Soothing Dance
expedition.description: Seo-yoon treats wounded troops with traditional medicine, increasing Healing speed in the infirmary by 10%/20%/30%/40%/50%.
